name: The Onigami House
source:
Late 19th century, Japan

Kyoko’s father has gone missing and she receives a mysterious letter from the master of the Onigami House, where her father last worked. What secrets will she uncover when she answers the request?

[From [url=http://kirime.geekpink.com/onigami/story/]Official Website[/url]]
translation:
19世纪末，日本

杏子的父亲失踪了，她收到一封来自她父亲最后工作的鬼神屋主人的神秘信件。当她答应这个请求时，又会发现什么秘密呢？
